lines.2: It seemed that dream was not to be.
lines.3: 「I-I don't know what it's about, but she looked angry, so maybe you should apologize?」
lines.5: 「Subaru, sorry, but give me Operation T in one minute.」
lines.6: 「Honestly, you're such a pain to look after.」
lines.7: 「Though I guess that's what I like about you.」
lines.8: Can't hear you. Can't hear you.
lines.9: 「I believe I summoned you yesterday--but never mind that.」
lines.11: 「Your parents should already have told you, but starting this weekend, I will--」
lines.12: 「Hold on, I'm getting a call. Excuse me.」
lines.13: 「What's that? Mm-hmm. I see. The Pillow-Flipping Yokai appeared and flipped Crab's pillow? That's a crisis for the whole village.」
lines.14: 「Sorry, something urgent came up. I have to go.」
lines.15: 「Hmm. I don't quite understand, but if it is urgent, it cannot be helped.」
lines.16: 「Then we will speak at our leisure after school. Wait for me in your classroom.」
